value: The library's whitespace-insensitive bigram similarity gives inconsistent scores for non-ASCII text. For example, the strings éa and éab share one of three total scalar-value bigrams and should score 2/3. Diagnose and repair the Unicode behavior. Count Unicode scalar-value bigrams, preserve duplicate multiplicity, whitespace removal, equal-input behavior and existing ASCII behavior. Unequal inputs with fewer than two scalars after whitespace removal score zero. Preserve existing APIs.
